Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent square RimWorld mushroom plant unit sprite, variant A.
Input 1 is a STYLE reference only: match its bold dark warm-brown outlines, simple flat 2D silhouette, two or three muted cel-shaded color planes, slight view from above, clean game-icon readability. Input 2 is a SPECIES SHAPE reference only for poison fire coral fungus (붉은사슴뿔버섯).
Draw one SMALL coherent unit of this fungus: three to four upright slender scarlet/vermilion rounded-tip clubs, of unequal lengths, joined near a compact base. One gentle fork is enough. Largest club at center-left, shorter club at right. Blunt softly rounded tips, subtly tapering bodies. This is a terrestrial club fungus, NOT sea coral, not a hand, not flames. Do not add caps or ordinary mushroom stems. Smooth matte scarlet red main faces, dark brick-red shadow plane, restrained lighter red highlight planes. Keep outlining weight similar to the style reference. No photographic texture, no glossy 3D lighting, no fine noise.
Composition: single isolated mature plant unit centered in a square, around 70 percent of canvas height, with at least 15 percent safe transparent space around. Root at bottom of subject. Actual transparent alpha background; no checker pattern, no solid backdrop. Do not include soil, grass, moss, logs, roots, rocks, base platform, shadow, box, other objects, labels, skulls, warning markings, text or watermark. Exactly one sprite, not a sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent square RimWorld mushroom plant unit sprite, mature variant B.
Input 1 is the accepted poison fire coral PlantA sprite: preserve the same species, scarlet/vermilion/brick-red palette, bold dark brown outlines and simple 2D game icon language. Input 2 is its real species reference only. Input 3 is the established button mushroom sprite style.
Create a SECOND mature variation, not an earlier growth stage: THREE main slender upright rounded-tip club fingers connected at a small base, with one short lateral lobe. Tallest finger now slightly to the RIGHT, gently curving right; the left one bends subtly outward; middle shorter finger peeks between. Unequal natural heights and a few simple broad flat shadow shapes. Do not simply mirror A. The clubs are smooth cylindrical fungal fruiting bodies without mushroom caps, sea-coral branching, palms, flame tips, or flowers.
Use only 2-3 matte cel-shaded tones per form with no granular texture, photographic detail, 3D shine or gradients. Thick clean warm dark-brown contour like the button reference. Slight view from above consistent with other game plants.
One compact isolated unit in a square; keep entire silhouette inside central 70 percent of canvas with generous actual transparent margins. Genuine alpha transparency, no drawn checkerboard. No soil, grass, moss, logs, roots, rocks, platform, drop shadow, box, text, symbols, skulls, warnings or watermarks. Exactly one sprite, not a sheet.
